cards.name: Dire Tactics
lines: Exile target creature. If you don't control a Human, you lose life equal to that creature's toughness.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No value reads the toughness of a targeted creature, so the life loss equal to that creature's toughness cannot be stated.

cards.name: Hurl Through Hell
lines: Exile target creature. Until the end of your next turn, you may cast that card and you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast that spell.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect grants the exiled card a cast permission lasting until the end of the controller's next turn with any-color mana spending; the closest ops (exileAndCastNextUpkeep, exileLibraryTop grantCastUntilEot) use different durations.

cards.name: See the Truth
lines: Look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of those cards into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order. If this spell was cast from anywhere other than your hand, put each of those cards into your hand instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No condition reads whether this spell was cast from a zone other than hand, so the 'put each of those cards into your hand instead' branch cannot be gated exactly.

cards.name: Grindstone
lines: {3}, {T}: Target player mills two cards. If two cards that share a color were milled this way, repeat this process.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema cannot test whether two milled cards share a color, so the 'if two cards that share a color were milled this way, repeat this process' clause cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Hatchery Sliver
lines: Each Sliver spell you cast has replicate. The replicate cost is equal to its mana cost.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Granting replicate to each other Sliver spell with a replicate cost equal to that spell's own mana cost has no schema form, since optionalAdditionalCost is a fixed cost and no static grants it to spells.

cards.name: Nimble Obstructionist
lines: When you cycle this card, counter target activated or triggered ability you don't control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no trigger for cycling this card, so 'when you cycle this card' cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Mystifying Maze
lines: {4}, {T}: Exile target attacking creature an opponent controls. At the beginning of the next end step, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: exileTargetReturnAtNextEndStep returns the card with no tapped option, so the 'return it tapped' part has no schema form.

cards.name: Sojourner's Companion
lines: Artifact landcycling {2}
cards.backTranslation:
Activate only from your hand.
{2}, Discard this card: Search your library for an artifact land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. You don't have to find one.

cards.name: Echoing Return
lines: Return target creature card and all other cards with the same name as that card from your graveyard to your hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect returns all other cards with the same name as the target from the graveyard along with it; the schema only returns the single targeted card.

cards.name: Defiling Daemogoth
lines: At the beginning of your end step, each opponent loses X life, where X is the amount of life you gained this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no value for the amount of life you gained this turn, so the 'each opponent loses X life' amount cannot be stated.

cards.name: Linden, the Steadfast Queen
lines: Whenever a white creature you control attacks, you gain 1 life.

cards.name: Eusocial Engineering
lines: Warp {1}{G}
cards.inexpressibleReason: Warp (cast for the warp cost, exile at the next end step, then castable later from exile) has no alternative-cast kind or delayed-exile form in the schema.

cards.name: Suki, Courageous Rescuer
lines: Whenever another permanent you control leaves the battlefield during your turn, create a 1/1 white Ally creature token. This ability triggers only once each turn.
cards.backTranslation: Once each turn, when another permanent you control leaves the battlefield, if it's your turn, create a 1/1 white Ally creature token.

cards.name: Willbreaker
lines: Whenever a creature an opponent controls becomes the target of a spell or ability you control, gain control of that creature for as long as you control this creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: 'For as long as you control this creature' is not the whileSourceOnBattlefield duration, and the becomesTargeted trigger cannot restrict the targeting spell or ability to ones you control.

cards.name: Lapse of Certainty
lines: Counter target spell. If that spell is countered this way, put it on top of its owner's library instead of into that player's graveyard.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The counter effect can only exile a countered spell or leave it in the graveyard, and the library option only sends a spell to the bottom, so putting the countered spell on top of its owner's library cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Time Reversal
lines: Each player shuffles their hand and graveyard into their library, then draws seven cards. Exile ~.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect shuffles every player's hand and graveyard into their library (shuffleHandGraveyardIntoLibrary has no each-player scope), so the first clause cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Hancock, Ghoulish Mayor
lines: Each other creature you control that's a Zombie or Mutant gets +X/+X, where X is the number of counters on ~.
validatorIssues: Invalid ability IR at definition.staticEffects[0].op.power: static value the layer engine cannot evaluate
Invalid ability IR at definition.staticEffects[0].op.toughness: static value the layer engine cannot evaluate
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no layer-evaluable static value for the total number of counters of all kinds on this creature (only countersOnSelf for one named counter type).

cards.name: Perforating Artist
lines: At the beginning of your end step, if you attacked this turn, each opponent loses 3 life unless that player sacrifices a nonland permanent of their choice or discards a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no Condition for 'you attacked this turn', and no end-step damage-or-loss effect with the 'unless that player sacrifices a nonland permanent or discards a card' choice.

cards.name: Tori D'Avenant, Fury Rider
lines: Whenever ~ attacks, all other attacking creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn. Other red attacking creatures you control gain trample until end of turn. Untap each other white attacking creature you control.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever this creature attacks, each other attacking creature you control gets +1/+1 until end of turn. Each other attacking red creature you control gains trample until end of turn. Untap each other attacking white creature you control.

cards.name: Narci, Fable Singer
lines: Whenever the final chapter ability of a Saga you control resolves, each opponent loses X life and you gain X life, where X is that Saga's mana value.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No trigger fires when the final chapter ability of a Saga resolves, and no value reads a Saga's mana value as the trigger's source.

cards.name: Ruins of Oran-Rief
lines: {T}: Put a +1/+1 counter on target colorless creature that entered this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The target restriction 'colorless creature' cannot be expressed: the selector has no colorless leaf (its color leaf takes only W, U, B, R or G).

cards.name: Goblin Grenade
lines: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a Goblin.
cards.backTranslation: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a Goblin you control. This spell does nothing else.
differences: Text B says 'This spell does nothing else', so it omits the spell's effect of dealing 5 damage to any target that Text A includes.

cards.name: Root Sliver
lines: Sliver spells can't be countered.
cards.backTranslation: Sliver creatures can't be countered.
differences: Text A makes all Sliver spells uncounterable, including noncreature Sliver spells; Text B only covers Sliver creature spells, so a noncreature Sliver spell can be countered under B.

cards.name: Ramses, Assassin Lord
lines: Whenever a player loses the game, if they were attacked this turn by an Assassin you controlled, you win the game.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No trigger fires when a player loses the game, so 'whenever a player loses the game, if they were attacked this turn by an Assassin you controlled, you win the game' cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Jiang Yanggu, Wildcrafter
lines: Each creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it has "{T}: Add one mana of any color."
cards.backTranslation: Creatures you control that have a +1/+1 counter on them have "Add one mana of any of the colors white, blue, black, red, and green."
differences: Text A grants a mana ability with the cost {T}; Text B grants 'Add one mana...' with no tap cost, so the granted ability could be used without tapping the creature, repeatedly and without summoning sickness limits.

cards.name: Celestial Mantle
lines: Whenever enchanted creature deals combat damage to a player, double its controller's life total.
cards.inexpressibleReason: 'Double its controller's life total' needs the life total of the enchanted creature's controller, but lifeTotal scope offers only you or the event player, and no target-free effect names the attached creature's controller.

cards.name: Military Intelligence
lines: Whenever you attack with two or more creatures, draw a card.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever you attack with two or more creatures, draw a card.

cards.name: Fatestitcher
lines: {T}: You may tap or untap another target permanent.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The 'you may' (choosing neither tapping nor untapping the target) has no form on an activated ability, since Ability.optional is documented only for triggered abilities.

cards.name: Into the Pit
lines: You may cast spells from the top of your library by sacrificing a nonland permanent in addition to paying their other costs.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Casting spells from the top of the library with an additional cost of sacrificing a nonland permanent has no schema form; castFromZone carries no extra sacrifice cost.

cards.name: Batwing Brume
lines: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt this turn if {W} was spent to cast this spell. Each player loses 1 life for each attacking creature they control if {B} was spent to cast this spell.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no condition on which colored mana symbols were spent to cast the spell, so the 'if {W} was spent' and 'if {B} was spent' riders cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Long River Lurker
lines: When this creature enters, target creature you control can't be blocked this turn. Whenever that creature deals combat damage this turn, you may exile it. If you do, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The delayed 'whenever that creature deals combat damage this turn' trigger cannot be expressed exactly, because the only matching event (dealsCombatDamageToPlayer) misses combat damage dealt to a planeswalker.

cards.name: Abyssal Persecutor
lines: You can't win the game and your opponents can't lose the game.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no static or rule that stops its controller from winning the game or lets opponents avoid losing it.

cards.name: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron
lines: Activated abilities of creatures you control cost {X} less to activate, where X is ~'s power. This effect can't reduce the mana in that cost to less than one mana.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The activation cost reduction has no schema-verified filter for creatures' activated abilities, since filter is defined only for spells.

cards.name: Loyal Unicorn
lines: At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control your commander, prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to creatures you control this turn. Other creatures you control gain vigilance until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Preventing combat damage dealt to creatures you control this turn has no effect form: createDamageShield covers damage to a player or to one object, and preventCombatDamageAll covers all combat damage.

cards.name: Winged Hive Tyrant
lines: The Will of the Hive Mind — Other creatures you control with counters on them have flying and haste.
cards.backTranslation: Other creatures you control that have a counter on them have flying and haste.

cards.name: Necrotic Hex
lines: Each player sacrifices six creatures of their choice. You create six tapped 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens.
cards.backTranslation:
Each player sacrifices six creatures.
Create six tapped 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens.

cards.name: The Mouth of Sauron
lines: When ~ enters, target player mills three cards. Then amass Orcs X, where X is the number of instant and sorcery cards in that player's graveyard.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The amass count is the number of instant and sorcery cards in the targeted player's graveyard, but countCardsInZone counts only your, the opponents', or all graveyards, not a chosen target player's.

cards.name: Prismatic Undercurrents
lines: Vivid — When this enchantment enters, search your library for up to X basic land cards, where X is the number of colors among permanents you control. Reveal those cards, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
cards.backTranslation: When this enters, search your library for a number of basic land cards equal to the number of colors among permanents, reveal them, and put them into your hand. The search may fail to find. Then shuffle.
differences: Text A counts colors among permanents you control; Text B counts colors among all permanents, dropping the 'you control' restriction, so opponents' permanents would be counted.

cards.name: Halo Forager
lines: When this creature enters, you may pay {X}. When you do, you may cast target instant or sorcery card with mana value X from a graveyard without paying its mana cost. If that spell would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The optional payment of a variable {X} cost that sets the mana value of the instant or sorcery cast from a graveyard has no schema shape, since mayPayManaThenReflexive takes only a fixed cost.

cards.name: Sandstorm Verge
lines: {3}, {T}: Target creature can't block this turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.backTranslation: {3}, {T}: Target creature can't block this turn. Activate only as a sorcery.

cards.name: Oath of Gideon
lines: Each planeswalker you control enters with an additional loyalty counter on it.
cards.backTranslation: Each planeswalker you control enters the battlefield with an additional loyalty counter on it.

cards.name: Trickbind
lines: Counter target activated or triggered ability. If a permanent's ability is countered this way, activated abilities of that permanent can't be activated this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: A stack target that is an activated OR triggered ability cannot be expressed (stackKind allows only one), and the rule that the countered permanent's activated abilities can't be activated this turn has no schema form.

cards.name: The Swarmweaver
lines: As long as there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, Insects and Spiders you control get +1/+1 and have deathtouch.
cards.backTranslation:
As long as there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, each Insect or Spider you control gets +1/+1.
As long as there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, each Insect or Spider you control has deathtouch.

cards.name: Samurai's Katana
lines: Job select
cards.inexpressibleReason: Any non-empty patch disables the engine's generic ability-label stripping, so the labeled line "Murasame — Equip {5}" becomes unrecognized and cannot be marked handled.

cards.name: Dream-Thief's Bandana
lines: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, look at the top card of their library, then exile it face down. For as long as it remains exiled, you may play it, and mana of any type can be spent to cast that spell.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, look at the top card of that player's library and exile it face down. The rest of that library is put on the bottom in random order. The exiled card may be played, not only cast, and may be of any card type.
differences: Text B adds that the rest of the library is put on the bottom in random order; Text A has no such effect.
Text B says the exiled card may be of any card type; Text A has no such restriction on card type.
Text A says mana of any type can be spent to cast the exiled card; Text B does not mention this.

cards.name: Mire in Misery
lines: Each opponent sacrifices a creature or enchantment of their choice.
cards.backTranslation: Each opponent sacrifices a creature or enchantment.

cards.name: Windreader Sphinx
lines: Whenever a creature with flying attacks, you may draw a card.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever a creature with flying attacks, you may draw a card.

cards.name: Cindervines
lines: {1}, Sacrifice this enchantment: Destroy target artifact or enchantment. ~ deals 2 damage to that permanent's controller.
cards.backTranslation: {1}, Sacrifice this: Choose target artifact or enchantment. This deals 2 damage to that permanent's controller. Destroy that permanent.
differences: Text A destroys the target first and then deals 2 damage to that permanent's controller; Text B deals the 2 damage first and destroys the permanent afterward. The order of steps differs.

cards.name: Jolted Awake
lines: Choose up to one target artifact or creature card in your graveyard. You get {E}{E} . Then you may pay an amount of {E} equal to that card's mana value. If you do, return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
validatorIssues: override.def.spellAbility.effects[1].amount.target: effect target 0 does not reference an ordinary target slot
override.def.spellAbility.effects[1].amount.target: cardInGraveyard is incompatible with effect domains permanent, spell
override.def.spellAbility.effects[1].then[0].target: effect target 0 does not reference an ordinary target slot
cards.inexpressibleReason: Paying energy equal to the mana value of an 'up to one' chosen graveyard card has no value or effect reference for a variable-count slot (manaValueOfTarget requires an ordinary permanent target).

cards.name: Akroma's Vengeance
lines: Destroy all artifacts, creatures, and enchantments.
cards.backTranslation: Destroy each artifact, each creature, and each enchantment on the battlefield.

cards.name: Chameleon Colossus
lines: {2}{G}{G}: ~ gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is its power.
cards.backTranslation: {2}{G}{G}: Until end of turn, this creature gets +X/+X, where X is this creature's power.

cards.name: Assassin Initiate
lines: {1}: ~ gains your choice of flying, deathtouch, or lifelink until end of turn.
cards.backTranslation: {1}: Choose one — This creature gains flying until end of turn; or this creature gains deathtouch until end of turn; or this creature gains lifelink until end of turn.

cards.name: Crystalline Giant
lines: At the beginning of combat on your turn, choose a kind of counter at random that this creature doesn't have on it from among flying, first strike, deathtouch, hexproof, lifelink, menace, reach, trample, vigilance, and +1/+1. Put a counter of that kind on this creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: A random choice of a counter kind from a list, excluding kinds already on the creature, has no schema form, and flying, first strike, deathtouch and the other keyword counters are not counter kinds the schema can name.

cards.name: Oakhame Adversary
lines: This spell costs {2} less to cast if an opponent controls a green permanent.
cards.backTranslation: This spell costs {2} less to cast if an opponent controls at least one green permanent.

cards.name: Verdant Embrace
lines: Enchanted creature gets +3/+3 and has "At the beginning of each upkeep, create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token."
cards.backTranslation:
Enchanted creature gets +3/+3.
Enchanted creature has "At the beginning of each player's upkeep, create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token."

cards.name: Combustion Man
lines: Whenever ~ attacks, destroy target permanent unless its controller has ~ deal damage to them equal to his power.
cards.inexpressibleReason: unlessPays takes only a mana cost, so 'unless its controller has this creature deal damage to them' has no schema form.

cards.name: Smoke
lines: Players can't untap more than one creature during their untap steps.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no rule static that limits how many creatures players may untap during their untap steps.

cards.name: Theoretical Duplication
lines: Whenever a nontoken creature an opponent controls enters this turn, create a token that's a copy of that creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Withheld by the main thread: the compiled patch's smoke game never finished (its delayed enters trigger also fires on the token copies it creates, so the game loops without a decision), and the smoke harness has no time limit.

cards.name: Haldir, Lórien Lieutenant
lines: {5}{G}: Until end of turn, other Elves you control gain vigilance and get +1/+1 for each +1/+1 counter on ~.
cards.backTranslation: {5}{G}: Other Elves you control gain vigilance until end of turn. Other Elves you control get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of +1/+1 counters on this creature.

cards.name: Maelstrom Archangel
lines: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you may cast a spell from your hand without paying its mana cost.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you may cast any card from your hand without paying its mana cost.

cards.name: Bane's Contingency
lines: Counter target spell. If that spell targets a commander you control, instead counter that spell, scry 2, then draw a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No condition can test whether the targeted spell targets a commander you control, so the alternate counter-scry-draw branch cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Elvish Guidance
lines: Whenever enchanted land is tapped for mana, its controller adds an additional {G} for each Elf on the battlefield.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The extra {G} per Elf on the battlefield is a state-derived amount, and the schema's manaActivationRider adds only fixed units.

cards.name: Espers to Magicite
lines: Exile each opponent's graveyard. When you do, choose up to one target creature card exiled this way. Create a token that's a copy of that card, except it's an artifact and it loses all other card types.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The token copy 'except it's an artifact and it loses all other card types' needs createTokenCopyOf to remove the copied card types, but it can only add types.

cards.name: Fiery Gambit
lines: Flip a coin until you lose a flip or choose to stop flipping. If you lose a flip, ~ has no effect. If you win one or more flips, ~ deals 3 damage to target creature. If you win two or more flips, ~ deals 6 damage to each opponent. If you win three or more flips, draw nine cards and untap all lands you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no repeated coin-flip loop that stops at the first lost flip or on a player's choice and then branches on the count of won flips (one, two, three or more), so the 3, 6 and nine-card-draw-and-untap tiers cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Cosmic Rebirth
lines: Choose target permanent card in your graveyard. If it has mana value 3 or less, you may put it onto the battlefield. If you don't put it onto the battlefield, put it into your hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The choice to put the targeted card with mana value 3 or less onto the battlefield, with the hand as the fallback, has no schema shape, since graveyardToBattlefield is mandatory and no optional put exists.

cards.name: Fungal Plots
lines: {1}{G}, Exile a creature card from your graveyard: Create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The cost 'exile a creature card from your graveyard' has no cost component that exiles a graveyard card matching a type filter; exileOtherCardsFromGraveyard takes only a count.

cards.name: The Stasis Coffin
lines: {2}, {T}, Exile ~: You gain protection from everything until your next turn.
cards.backTranslation: {2}, {T}, Exile this artifact: You gain protection from everything until your next turn.

cards.name: Hungry Lynx
lines: Cats you control have protection from Rats.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Protection from a creature subtype (Rats) is not a ProtectionQuality; only colors, multicolored and creatures exist.

cards.name: Banishing Knack
lines: Until end of turn, target creature gains "{T}: Return target nonland permanent to its owner's hand."
cards.inexpressibleReason: The granted ability needs a {T} cost, but grantAbilityUntilEot carries a bare Ability with no cost field, and no effect grants an activated ability with a cost until end of turn.

cards.name: Kellan, the Kid
lines: Whenever you cast a spell from anywhere other than your hand, you may cast a permanent spell with equal or lesser mana value from your hand without paying its mana cost. If you don't, you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema cannot express casting a permanent spell from hand with mana value equal to or less than the triggering spell's mana value (castOneFromHandFreeUpTo takes a fixed maxManaValue), combined with the 'if you don't, put a land card onto the battlefield' fallback.

cards.name: Furnace Reins
lines: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. Until end of turn, it gains haste and "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player or battle, create a Treasure token."
cards.inexpressibleReason: The granted trigger covers combat damage to a player or battle, and the schema's combat-damage trigger has no battle form.

cards.name: Galvanic Discharge
lines: Choose target creature or planeswalker. You get {E}{E}{E} , then you may pay any amount of {E}. ~ deals that much damage to that permanent.
cards.backTranslation:
Target creature or planeswalker.
You get three {E}.
You may pay any amount of {E} up to the amount of energy you have. If you do, this spell deals damage equal to the amount of energy paid to that permanent.

cards.name: Turn Aside
lines: Counter target spell that targets a permanent you control.
cards.backTranslation: Counter target spell that targets a permanent you control.

cards.name: Through the Forest Gate
lines: Look at the top twenty cards of your library, put any number of land cards from among them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. You gain 8 life.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Putting any number of land cards from the top twenty onto the battlefield, with the rest staying in the library before a required shuffle, has no schema shape (lookAtTopN takes a fixed pick count and moves the rest to the bottom or top).

cards.name: Shaman of Forgotten Ways
lines: {9}{G}{G}, {T}: Each player's life total becomes the number of creatures they control. Activate only if creatures you control have total power 8 or greater.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The effect 'each player's life total becomes the number of creatures they control' sets life totals, and the schema has no life-total-setting effect.

cards.name: Self-Destruct
lines: Target creature you control deals X damage to any other target and X damage to itself, where X is its power.
cards.backTranslation:
Target creature you control and target any target other than that creature.
That creature deals damage equal to its power to the other target.
That creature deals damage equal to its power to itself.

cards.name: Disruption Protocol
lines: As an additional cost to cast this spell, tap an untapped artifact you control or pay {1}.
cards.inexpressibleReason: spellAdditionalCosts are all paid together, so the schema cannot say the either/or additional cost 'tap an untapped artifact you control or pay {1}'.

cards.name: Myr Galvanizer
lines: {1}, {T}: Untap each other Myr you control.
cards.backTranslation: {1}, {T}: Untap each other creature Myr you control.

cards.name: Pia Nalaar, Consul of Revival
lines: Whenever you play a land from exile or cast a spell from exile, create a 1/1 colorless Thopter artifact creature token with flying.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no trigger for playing a land from exile, and castsSpell can narrow the cast source to 'notHand' or 'graveyard' but not exactly 'from exile'.

cards.name: Glimmerpost
lines: When this land enters, you gain 1 life for each Locus on the battlefield.
cards.backTranslation: When this land enters, you gain 1 life for each permanent with the subtype Locus on the battlefield, under any player's control.

cards.name: Mutinous Massacre
lines: Choose odd or even. Destroy each creature with mana value of the chosen quality. Then gain control of all creatures until end of turn. Untap them. They gain haste until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The odd-or-even choice made on resolution has no effect or selector that destroys creatures by a chosen mana-value parity.

cards.name: Ghost Town
lines: {0}: Return this land to its owner's hand. Activate only if it's not your turn.
cards.backTranslation: {0}: Return this to its owner's hand. Activate only if it is not your turn.

cards.name: Norin the Wary
lines: When a player casts a spell or a creature attacks, exile ~. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
cards.backTranslation:
Whenever a player casts a spell, exile this creature. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
Whenever an attacker is declared, exile this creature. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
differences: Text A is one triggered ability that fires when a player casts a spell or when a creature attacks, so it triggers once for each attacking creature. Text B splits this into two abilities, and its attack trigger fires once per declared attackers step (on 'an attacker is declared') rather than once for each attacking creature.

cards.name: Crawling Barrens
lines: {4}: Put two +1/+1 counters on this land. Then you may have it become a 0/0 Elemental creature until end of turn. It's still a land.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no optional effect for an activated ability ('you may have it become a 0/0 creature' after the counters), since Ability.optional applies only to triggered abilities.

cards.name: Command the Dreadhorde
lines: Choose any number of target creature and/or planeswalker cards in graveyards. ~ deals damage to you equal to the total mana value of those cards. Put them onto the battlefield under your control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Dealing damage equal to the total mana value of several chosen cards has no schema value, since manaValueOfTarget reads a single target and no total exists.

cards.name: Faerie Dreamthief
lines: {2}{B}, Exile this card from your graveyard: You draw a card and you lose 1 life.
cards.backTranslation: {2}{B}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Draw a card and lose 1 life. Activate only from your graveyard.

cards.name: Sokka's Charge
lines: During your turn, Allies you control have double strike and lifelink.
cards.backTranslation:
During your turn, Allies you control that are creatures have double strike.
During your turn, Allies you control that are creatures have lifelink.

cards.name: Esoteric Duplicator
lines: Whenever you sacrifice this artifact or another artifact, you may pay {2}. If you do, at the beginning of the next end step, create a token that's a copy of that artifact.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Copying the sacrificed artifact at the next end step needs a delayed copy of a permanent that has already left the battlefield, and no schema form copies a departed permanent from its last known information.

cards.name: Warkite Marauder
lines: Whenever this creature attacks, target creature defending player controls loses all abilities and has base power and toughness 0/1 until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect sets a targeted creature's base power and toughness to 0/1 while removing all its abilities until end of turn (loseAllAbilities exists only as a static layer 6 operation).

cards.name: The Ring Goes South
lines: The Ring tempts you. Then reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal X land cards, where X is the number of legendary creatures you control. Put those land cards onto the battlefield tapped and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no 'The Ring tempts you' effect and no reveal-until-X-land-cards effect whose X is a dynamic count of legendary creatures.

cards.name: Training Compound
lines: {T}: Add {R} or {G}. Activate only if this land entered this turn or if you control a basic land.
cards.backTranslation: {T}: Add {R} or {G}. Activate only if this entered this turn or you control at least one basic land.

cards.name: Earthshape
lines: Earthbend 3. Then each creature you control with power less than or equal to that land's power gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn. You gain hexproof until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Earthbend 3 (animating a land you control with three +1/+1 counters) has no schema form, and 'that land's power' has no reference to it.

cards.name: Nemesis Mask
lines: All creatures able to block equipped creature do so.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no static that forces every creature able to block the equipped creature to block it; setMustBlockThisTurn is a one-shot effect on a single target, not a continuing requirement.

cards.name: Raphael, the Nightwatcher
lines: Sneak {1}{R}{R}
cards.inexpressibleReason: Sneak's result of the creature entering tapped and attacking has no alternative-cast field, so the cast cannot be modeled exactly.

cards.name: Esix, Fractal Bloom
lines: The first time you would create one or more tokens during each of your turns, you may instead choose a creature other than ~ and create that many tokens that are copies of that creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The once-per-turn optional replacement that makes your token creation instead create copies of a chosen other creature has no schema form (tokenCountMultiplier only doubles counts).

cards.name: Stoic Rebuttal
lines: This spell costs {1} less to cast if you control three or more artifacts.
cards.backTranslation:
This spell has no effect other than its cost reduction.
This spell costs {1} less to cast as long as you control three or more artifacts.
differences: Text A's spell counters target spell; Text B says the spell does nothing beyond its cost reduction, omitting the counter effect entirely.

cards.name: Industrial Advancement
lines: At the beginning of your end step, you may sacrifice a creature. If you do, look at the top X cards of your library, where X is that creature's mana value. You may put a creature card from among them onto the battlefield. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Looking at the top X cards, where X is the sacrificed creature's mana value, needs a dynamic count, but lookAtTopN takes a fixed number and the sacrifice is not optional.

cards.name: Drana, the Last Bloodchief
lines: Whenever ~ attacks, defending player chooses a nonlegendary creature card in your graveyard. You return that card to the battlefield with an additional +1/+1 counter on it. The creature is a Vampire in addition to its other types.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The defending player chooses which nonlegendary creature card in your graveyard returns, and the schema has no effect where an opponent makes that choice for the controller's return.

cards.name: Virulent Sliver
lines: All Sliver creatures have poisonous 1.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Poisonous 1 is not a keyword the schema can grant (keywords are a closed list with no poisonous entry, and the only parameterized poison-related field is toxic on the card itself).

cards.name: Empty the Laboratory
lines: Sacrifice X Zombies, then reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a number of Zombie creature cards equal to the number of Zombies sacrificed this way. Put those cards onto the battlefield and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No op reveals cards until a count equal to the number just sacrificed is reached and puts only the matching Zombie creature cards onto the battlefield.

cards.name: Thorn of Amethyst
lines: Noncreature spells cost {1} more to cast.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The only cost-increase static (opponentNonHandSpellCostIncrease) applies to opponents' non-hand spells, and no rule static raises the cost of all players' noncreature spells.

cards.name: Dire Fleet Ravager
lines: When this creature enters, each player loses a third of their life, rounded up.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No Value expresses a third of a player's life rounded up; the schema has no division, so each player's life loss cannot be stated.

cards.name: Thunderous Velocipede
lines: Each other Vehicle and creature you control enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it if its mana value is 4 or less. Otherwise, it enters with three additional +1/+1 counters on it.
cards.backTranslation:
Each other permanent you control that is a creature or has the subtype Vehicle, with mana value 4 or less, enters the battlefield with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
Each other permanent you control that is a creature or has the subtype Vehicle, with mana value 5 or more, enters the battlefield with three additional +1/+1 counters on it.

cards.name: Plague Drone
lines: Rot Fly — If an opponent would gain life, that player loses that much life instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No replacement effect in the schema turns an opponent's life gain into life loss (Rot Fly).

cards.name: Spirit Loop
lines: Whenever enchanted creature deals damage, you gain that much life.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No trigger fires when the enchanted creature deals any damage; the damage triggers cover only combat damage to a player, damage to an opponent, or damage received.

cards.name: Sanctum of Shattered Heights
lines: {1}, Discard a land card or Shrine card: ~ deals X damage to target creature or planeswalker, where X is the number of Shrines you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The discard cost "Discard a land card or Shrine card" has no selector; discardCard takes only a count, so it cannot restrict the discarded card to lands or Shrines.

cards.name: Moritte of the Frost
lines: You may have ~ enter as a copy of a permanent you control, except it's legendary and snow in addition to its other types and, if it's a creature, it enters with two additional +1/+1 counters on it and has changeling.
cards.inexpressibleReason: entersAsCopy cannot add the supertypes legendary and snow, and its counter option cannot give two +1/+1 counters only when the copy is a creature.

cards.name: Ishai, Ojutai Dragonspeaker
lines: Partner
cards.inexpressibleReason: The Partner keyword (CR 702.124) has no keyword or static form in the schema; only the named-partner trigger shape exists.

cards.name: Ochre Jelly
lines: Split — When this creature dies, if it had two or more +1/+1 counters on it, create a token that's a copy of it at the beginning of the next end step. The token enters with half that many +1/+1 counters on it, rounded down.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The delayed token copy must enter with floor(half) of the dead creature's +1/+1 counters, and no effect can place a computed counter count on a created token copy.

cards.name: Rakdos, the Showstopper
lines: When ~ enters, flip a coin for each creature that isn't a Demon, Devil, or Imp. Destroy each creature whose coin comes up tails.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Flipping a separate coin for each creature that is not a Demon, Devil, or Imp, then destroying those whose coin lands tails, has no schema shape (flipCoin is a single coin flip).

cards.name: Inferno of the Star Mounts
lines: {R}: ~ gets +1/+0 until end of turn. When its power becomes 20 this way, it deals 20 damage to any target.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The 20-damage 'any target' effect happens only when this activation makes its power exactly 20, but an activated ability announces its targets on every activation, so the required target cannot be chosen only in that case.

cards.name: Words of Wisdom
lines: You draw two cards, then each other player draws a card.
cards.backTranslation:
Draw two cards.
Each opponent draws a card.
differences: Text A says each other player draws a card, which covers every player except you. Text B says each opponent draws a card, which covers only opponents. Players who are not opponents (for example teammates in a team game) would draw under A but not under B.

cards.name: Mogg Salvage
lines: If an opponent controls an Island and you control a Mountain, you may cast this spell without paying its mana cost.
cards.backTranslation:
You may cast this spell without paying its mana cost if an opponent controls an Island and you control a Mountain.
This spell does nothing.
differences: Text A's spell destroys target artifact on resolution; Text B says the spell does nothing, omitting the destroy effect entirely.

cards.name: Tectonic Reformation
lines: Each land card in your hand has cycling {R}.
cards.inexpressibleReason: A static effect cannot grant an activated cycling ability to the land cards in your hand, because statics only reach battlefield permanents.

cards.name: Legions to Ashes
lines: Exile target nonland permanent an opponent controls and all tokens that player controls with the same name as that permanent.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect that exiles all tokens an opponent controls sharing the name of the targeted permanent, since a name selector is fixed text and cannot take the target's name.

cards.name: Werebear
lines: ~ gets +3/+3 as long as there are seven or more cards in your graveyard.
cards.backTranslation: As long as seven or more cards are in your graveyard, this creature gets +3/+3.

cards.name: Spider-Man, Brooklyn Visionary
lines: Web-slinging {2}{G}
cards.inexpressibleReason: Web-slinging's alternative cost requires returning a tapped creature you control to its owner's hand as part of the cost, and no cost kind in the schema returns a creature to hand.

cards.name: Tainted Remedy
lines: If an opponent would gain life, that player loses that much life instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no replacement effect that turns an opponent's life gain into life loss; the schema has no life-gain replacement static.

cards.name: _____ Goblin
lines: When this creature enters, you may put a name sticker on it. Add {R} for each unique vowel on that sticker.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The name sticker and the mana added per unique vowel on it have no schema representation.

cards.name: Vampire Cutthroat
lines: Skulk
cards.inexpressibleReason: Skulk (can't be blocked by creatures with greater power) is not a keyword or static in the schema.

cards.name: Leinore, Autumn Sovereign
lines: At the beginning of combat on your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on up to one target creature you control. Then if you control three or more creatures with different powers, draw a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no condition or value counting creatures with different powers, which the 'if you control three or more creatures with different powers, draw a card' clause needs.

cards.name: Unexplained Absence
lines: For each player, exile up to one target nonland permanent that player controls. For each permanent exiled this way, its controller cloaks the top card of their library.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no cloak effect: the controller of each exiled permanent must cloak the top card of their library (a face-down 2/2 with ward {2}), and the schema only has manifest.

cards.name: Retribution of the Ancients
lines: {B}, Remove X +1/+1 counters from among creatures you control: Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The cost 'remove X +1/+1 counters from among creatures you control' needs an announced X paid as a cost, but removeCountersFromAmong takes a fixed count and activation has no X announcement.

cards.name: Adelbert Steiner
lines: ~ gets +1/+1 for each Equipment you control.
cards.backTranslation: This creature gets +1/+1 for each Equipment you control.

cards.name: Soulcatchers' Aerie
lines: Whenever a Bird is put into your graveyard from the battlefield, put a feather counter on this enchantment.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever a Bird you own leaves the battlefield and goes to a graveyard, put a feather counter on this enchantment.

cards.name: Crumbling Ashes
lines: At the beginning of your upkeep, destroy target creature with a -1/-1 counter on it.
cards.backTranslation: At the beginning of your upkeep, destroy target creature that has a -1/-1 counter on it.

cards.name: Goblin Piledriver
lines: Whenever this creature attacks, it gets +2/+0 until end of turn for each other attacking Goblin.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever this creature attacks, it gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is twice the number of other attacking Goblins.

cards.name: Marcus, Mutant Mayor
lines: Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, draw a card if that creature has a +1/+1 counter on it. If it doesn't, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, if that creature has a +1/+1 counter on it, draw a card. Otherwise, put a +1/+1 counter on that creature.

cards.name: Krang, the All-Powerful
lines: If a player drawing a card causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.
cards.inexpressibleReason: triggerAdditionalTime only doubles triggers of permanents matching a filter; it cannot require that the triggering event was a player drawing a card.

cards.name: Great Intelligence's Plan
lines: Draw three cards. Then target opponent faces a villainous choice — They discard three cards, or you may cast a spell from your hand without paying its mana cost.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no villainous choice in which the target opponent picks between discarding three cards and letting the controller cast a spell free.

cards.name: Raff Capashen, Ship's Mage
lines: You may cast historic spells as though they had flash.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No static rule lets a permanent give historic spells you cast flash (casting as though they had flash); the only flash timing is per-card alternativeCasts.instantTiming.

cards.name: Memory Jar
lines: {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Each player exiles all cards from their hand face down and draws seven cards. At the beginning of the next end step, each player discards their hand and returns to their hand each card they exiled this way.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Each player exiling their whole hand face down, then at the next end step discarding and returning the exiled cards, has no schema form.

cards.name: Mausoleum Wanderer
lines: Sacrifice this creature: Counter target instant or sorcery spell unless its controller pays {X}, where X is this creature's power.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The sacrifice ability's counter-unless cost is {X}, where X is this creature's power, but counterUnlessControllerPays takes only a fixed ParsedManaCost, so the variable cost cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Nexus of Becoming
lines: At the beginning of combat on your turn, draw a card. Then you may exile an artifact or creature card from your hand. If you do, create a token that's a copy of the exiled card, except it's a 3/3 Golem artifact creature in addition to its other types.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Exiling a chosen artifact or creature card from hand and making a token copy of that card, except it is a 3/3 Golem artifact creature, cannot be expressed: the token copy spec adds types but not the Golem subtype, and no effect links a token copy to a card exiled from hand.

cards.name: Topiary Lecturer
lines: {T}: Add an amount of {G} equal to this creature's power.
validatorIssues: override.def.manaAbilities[0].amount: mana amount a mana ability cannot evaluate
cards.inexpressibleReason: A mana ability's amount cannot evaluate this creature's current power (powerOfSource is not mana-amount evaluable).

cards.name: Lure
lines: All creatures able to block enchanted creature do so.
cards.inexpressibleReason: A permanent static requiring all creatures able to block the enchanted creature to block it has no schema form; setMustBlockThisTurn is a one-turn effect only.

cards.name: Territorial Hellkite
lines: At the beginning of combat on your turn, choose an opponent at random that this creature didn't attack during your last combat. ~ attacks that player this combat if able. If you can't choose an opponent this way, tap this creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Choosing a random opponent that this creature did not attack during your last combat, with a forced attack on that player or else a tap, has no schema form.

cards.name: Sudden Substitution
lines: Exchange control of target noncreature spell and target creature. Then the spell's controller may choose new targets for it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect exchanges control of a target noncreature spell with a target creature; swapCreatureControlUntilEot only swaps creatures and lasts until end of turn.

cards.name: Gwaihir the Windlord
lines: This spell costs {2} less to cast as long as you've drawn two or more cards this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No condition reads how many cards you have drawn this turn, so the "two or more cards this turn" cost reduction cannot be stated.

cards.name: Tough Cookie
lines: {2}{G}: Until end of turn, target noncreature artifact you control becomes a 4/4 artifact creature.
cards.backTranslation: {2}{G}: Target artifact you control that isn't a creature becomes a 4/4 creature until end of turn.

cards.name: Exponential Growth
lines: Until end of turn, double target creature's power X times.
cards.inexpressibleReason: doublePowerTarget doubles power once, and no Value or op repeats the doubling X times (a 2^X result).

cards.name: Imposing Grandeur
lines: Each player may discard their hand and draw cards equal to the greatest mana value of a commander they own on the battlefield or in the command zone.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema cannot express each player's optional discard-hand-then-draw count set by the greatest mana value of commanders they own in the command zone or on the battlefield.

cards.name: Sapling of Colfenor
lines: Whenever ~ attacks, reveal the top card of your library. If it's a creature card, you gain life equal to that card's toughness, lose life equal to its power, then put it into your hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The attack trigger needs to reveal the top card and branch on its type, then gain life equal to that card's toughness and lose life equal to its power, and no schema value reads the revealed card's toughness or power.

cards.name: Soul Partition
lines: Exile target nonland permanent. For as long as that card remains exiled, its owner may play it. A spell cast by an opponent this way costs {2} more to cast.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The {2} cost increase on an opponent's casts of the exiled card has no schema form, since cost-change statics only reduce costs or apply to all spells.

cards.name: Fatespinner
lines: At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, that player chooses draw step, main phase, or combat phase. The player skips each instance of the chosen step or phase this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect that lets the affected player choose a step or phase and then skip each instance of it this turn.

cards.name: Historian's Boon
lines: Whenever the final chapter ability of a Saga you control triggers, create a 4/4 white Angel creature token with flying and vigilance.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The trigger for the final chapter ability of a Saga you control has no schema shape, since the chapter field takes a fixed chapter number and cannot express final.

cards.name: Collective Restraint
lines: Creatures can't attack you unless their controller pays {X} for each creature they control that's attacking you, where X is the number of basic land types among lands you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: attackTax takes a fixed number and cannot count the basic land types among lands you control (domain).

cards.name: Lotus Vale
lines: If this land would enter, sacrifice two untapped lands instead. If you do, put this land onto the battlefield. If you don't, put it into its owner's graveyard.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no as-enters replacement that sacrifices two untapped lands instead of entering; entersUnlessDiscard only models discarding a land card.

cards.name: Cabal Pit
lines: {B}, {T}, Sacrifice this land: Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn. Activate only if there are seven or more cards in your graveyard.
cards.backTranslation: {B}, {T}, Sacrifice this land: Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn. Activate only if there are seven or more cards in your graveyard.

cards.name: Generator Servant
lines: {T}, Sacrifice this creature: Add {C}{C}. If any of that mana is spent on a creature spell, it gains haste until end of turn.
cards.backTranslation:
{T}, Sacrifice this creature: Add {C}{C}.
When you spend this mana to cast a creature spell, that spell gains haste.
differences: Text A gives haste only until end of turn; Text B's haste has no duration, so the creature spell would keep haste beyond the turn.

cards.name: Magnetic Theft
lines: Attach target Equipment to target creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: attachSelfTo only attaches the ability's own source, and no effect attaches a targeted Equipment to a targeted creature.

cards.name: Kinetic Ooze
lines: When this creature enters, destroy up to one target artifact or enchantment with mana value X or less. If X is 5 or more, you draw a card. If X is 10 or more, double the number of +1/+1 counters on any number of other target creatures.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The destroy target filter 'mana value X or less' needs the announced X of the source, but the manaValueAtMost selector takes only a fixed number.

cards.name: Aggressive Biomancy
lines: Create X tokens that are copies of target creature you control, except they have "When this token enters, it fights up to one target creature you don't control."
cards.inexpressibleReason: createTokenCopyOf cannot grant the copies an extra 'when this token enters, it fights up to one target creature you don't control' triggered ability.

cards.name: Ironsoul Enforcer
lines: Whenever this creature or a commander you control attacks alone, return target artifact card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever this creature or a commander you control attacks alone, put target artifact card from your graveyard onto the battlefield.

cards.name: Yue, the Moon Spirit
lines: Waterbend {5}, {T}: You may cast a noncreature spell from your hand without paying its mana cost.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The free cast is limited to noncreature spells, but castOneFromHandFreeUpTo only takes a mana value ceiling and castAnyFromHandFree has no type filter; the waterbend helper-tap is also unmodeled.

cards.name: Werefox Bodyguard
lines: When this creature enters, exile up to one other target non-Fox creature until this creature leaves the battlefield.
validatorIssues: override.def.triggers[0].effects[0].targetSlot: effect target 0 does not reference an ordinary target slot
cards.backTranslation: When this enters, exile up to one target creature other than this that isn't a Fox until this leaves the battlefield.

cards.name: Tor Wauki the Younger
lines: If another source you control would deal noncombat damage to a permanent or player, it deals that much damage plus 1 to that permanent or player instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: damageDoubled and damageDoubledToOpponents double damage, and no damage replacement adds a fixed amount (+1) to noncombat damage from other sources you control.

cards.name: Mythos of Snapdax
lines: Each player chooses an artifact, a creature, an enchantment, and a planeswalker from among the nonland permanents they control, then sacrifices the rest. If {B}{R} was spent to cast this spell, you choose the permanents for each player instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema cannot condition the 'you choose the permanents for each player' branch on {B}{R} having been spent to cast the spell, so the two branches cannot both be expressed exactly.

cards.name: Assemble the Entmoot
lines: Sacrifice this enchantment: Create three tapped X/X green Treefolk creature tokens, where X is the amount of life you gained this turn. Put a reach counter on each of them.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No Value counts the life you gained this turn, and tokens have no reach-counter field.

cards.name: Citadel of Pain
lines: At the beginning of each player's end step, this enchantment deals X damage to that player, where X is the number of untapped lands they control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The damage amount is the number of untapped lands the event player controls, and the count values only scope to you, opponents or all, with no event-player scope and no untapped-count selector.

cards.name: Eruth, Tormented Prophet
lines: If you would draw a card, exile the top two cards of your library instead. You may play those cards this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The draw replacement (exile the top two cards instead of drawing, playable this turn) has no replacement-effect static in the schema.

cards.name: Claim the Firstborn
lines: Gain control of target creature with mana value 3 or less until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn.
cards.backTranslation: Gain control of target creature with mana value 3 or less until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn.

cards.name: Tome of the Guildpact
lines: Whenever you cast a multicolored spell, draw a card.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever you cast a spell that is at least two of the colors white, blue, black, red, and green, draw a card.

cards.name: Termagant Swarm
lines: Ravenous
validatorIssues: unrecognized rules text: "Death Frenzy — When this creature dies, create a number of 1/1 green Tyranid creature tokens equal to this creature's power."
cards.inexpressibleReason: Any non-empty patch disables the engine's generic ability-label stripping, so the labeled line "Death Frenzy — When this creature dies..." becomes unrecognized and cannot be marked handled.

cards.name: Plasm Capture
lines: Counter target spell. At the beginning of your next first main phase, add X mana in any combination of colors, where X is that spell's mana value.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The delayed next-first-main-phase mana is add X mana in any combination of colors, but the counter option adds only colorless mana ({C}) equal to the countered spell's mana value, so no colored-any delayed mana can be expressed.

cards.name: Horde of Notions
lines: {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}: You may play target Elemental card from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect lets the ability's controller play a targeted Elemental card from their graveyard without paying its mana cost; the free-cast effects only reach hand, library or exile.

cards.name: Layla Hassan
lines: When ~ enters and whenever one or more Assassins you control deal combat damage to a player, return target historic card from your graveyard to your hand.
cards.backTranslation:
When this enters, return target artifact, legendary, or Saga card in your graveyard to your hand.
Whenever one or more Assassins you control deal combat damage to a player, return target artifact, legendary, or Saga card in your graveyard to your hand. (Triggers once for each player dealt damage.)

cards.name: Chrome Dome
lines: {5}: Create a token that's a copy of another target artifact you control. That token gains haste. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
cards.backTranslation: {5}: Create a token that is a copy of target other artifact you control, except it has haste. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the end step.
differences: Text A sacrifices the token at the beginning of the next end step; Text B says the beginning of the end step, which can fire at a different end step (or none) when activated during an end step or after the relevant step has begun.

cards.name: Kaervek, the Punisher
lines: Whenever you commit a crime, exile up to one target black card from your graveyard and copy it. You may cast the copy. If you do, you lose 2 life.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no 'whenever you commit a crime' trigger event.

cards.name: G'raha Tia, Scion Reborn
lines: Throw Wide the Gates — Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, you may pay X life, where X is that spell's mana value. If you do, create a 1/1 colorless Hero creature token and put X +1/+1 counters on it. Do this only once each turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The mayPayLife condition takes a fixed amount, not the cast spell's mana value, so 'may pay X life where X is that spell's mana value' cannot be said, and a castsSpell trigger has no once-each-turn limit.

cards.name: Lunar Insight
lines: Draw a card for each different mana value among nonland permanents you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No Value counts the distinct mana values among nonland permanents you control.

cards.name: Demonic Ruckus
lines: Plot {R}
cards.inexpressibleReason: Plot (exile from hand, then cast later without paying the mana cost as a sorcery) is not a keyword or alternative-cast kind in the schema.

cards.name: Gift of Paradise
lines: Enchanted land has "{T}: Add two mana of any one color."
cards.backTranslation: Enchanted creature has "Add two mana in any combination of the colors white, blue, black, red, and green."
differences: Text A enchants a land and gives the enchanted land the ability; Text B gives the enchanted creature the ability (wrong object type).
Text A's granted ability requires {T} and taps the land; Text B has no tap cost.
Text A adds two mana of one chosen color; Text B adds two mana in any combination of the five colors, which can be two different colors.

cards.name: Adorned Pouncer
lines: Eternalize {3}{W}{W}
cards.inexpressibleReason: The eternalize token is a 4/4 black Zombie Cat, and createTokenCopyOf can override only power and toughness and add types; it cannot set the copy's color or add a subtype.

cards.name: Acclaimed Contender
lines: When this creature enters, if you control another Knight, look at the top five cards of your library. You may reveal a Knight, Aura, Equipment, or legendary artifact card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
cards.backTranslation: When this creature enters, if you control another Knight, look at the top five cards of your library. You may put a Knight, Aura, Equipment, or legendary artifact card from among them into your hand and reveal it. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

cards.name: Samut, Tyrant of Naktamun
lines: Instant and sorcery spells you control have split second.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Granting split second to instant and sorcery spells on the stack has no schema form, since staticEffects only affect permanents and no rule static grants keywords to spells.

cards.name: Black Cat, Cunning Thief
lines: When ~ enters, look at the top nine cards of target opponent's library, exile two of them face down, then put the rest on the bottom of their library in a random order. You may play the exiled cards for as long as they remain exiled. Mana of any type can be spent to cast spells this way.
cards.inexpressibleReason: exileFaceDownPlayable exiles only one card, but the line exiles two of the top nine cards face down, with the rest going to the bottom in random order.

cards.name: Constricting Sliver
lines: Sliver creatures you control have "When this creature enters, you may exile target creature an opponent controls until this creature leaves the battlefield."
cards.backTranslation: Each Sliver you control has "When this permanent enters, you may exile target creature an opponent controls until that permanent leaves the battlefield."
differences: Text A gives the granted ability only to Sliver creatures you control; Text B gives it to each Sliver you control, which would include any noncreature Sliver permanent.

cards.name: Cryptic Trilobite
lines: Remove a +1/+1 counter from this creature: Add {C}{C}. Spend this mana only to activate abilities.
cards.backTranslation: Remove a +1/+1 counter from this creature: Add {C}{C}. Spend this mana only to activate abilities.

cards.name: Glen Elendra's Answer
lines: Counter all spells your opponents control and all abilities your opponents control. Create a 1/1 blue and black Faerie creature token with flying for each spell and ability countered this way.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no mass counter effect for all opposing spells and abilities; counter needs a single target, and no effect creates a token per object countered this way.

cards.name: Justiciar's Portal
lines: Exile target creature you control, then return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control. It gains first strike until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: "It gains first strike until end of turn" refers to the creature after it is returned as a new object, and no effect grants a keyword to the blinked card itself after blinkTarget.

cards.name: Botanical Brawler
lines: Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on another permanent you control, if it's the first time +1/+1 counters have been put on that permanent this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The trigger's "first time +1/+1 counters have been put on that permanent this turn" is a per-permanent condition; oncePerTurn limits the whole ability, not each permanent, and no condition counts counter placements per object this turn.

cards.name: Solstice Revelations
lines: Exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost if the spell's mana value is less than the number of Mountains you control. If you don't cast that card this way, put it into your hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: exileLibraryTop has no mana-value gate on the free cast and no put-into-hand fallback, so the conditional cast cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Will, Scion of Peace
lines: {T}: Spells you cast this turn that are white and/or blue cost {X} less to cast, where X is the amount of life you gained this turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The ability reduces the cost of this turn's white and/or blue spells by the life you gained this turn, a one-shot turn-scoped reduction; costReduction is a permanent rule static and has no life-gained-this-turn amount.

cards.name: Titanic Ultimatum
lines: Until end of turn, creatures you control get +5/+5 and gain first strike, trample, and lifelink.
cards.backTranslation: Creatures you control get +5/+5 until end of turn. Creatures you control gain first strike until end of turn. Creatures you control gain trample until end of turn. Creatures you control gain lifelink until end of turn.

cards.name: Requiem Monolith
lines: {T}: Until end of turn, target creature gains "Whenever this creature is dealt damage, you draw that many cards and lose that much life." That creature's controller may have this artifact deal 1 damage to it. Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.inexpressibleReason: 'That creature's controller may have this artifact deal 1 damage to it' is a controller-chosen optional damage with no schema form.

cards.name: Teysa, Envoy of Ghosts
lines: Whenever a creature deals combat damage to you, destroy that creature. Create a 1/1 white and black Spirit creature token with flying.
cards.inexpressibleReason: 'A creature deals combat damage to you' cannot both restrict the damaged player to you and name the damaging creature as the object to destroy: dealsCombatDamageToPlayer does not name you, and playerDealtDamage gives no damaging object.

cards.name: Time Spiral
lines: Exile ~. Each player shuffles their hand and graveyard into their library, then draws seven cards. You untap up to six lands.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema's shuffleHandGraveyardIntoLibrary op does not state whether it applies to each player or only the controller, and the line requires each player to shuffle their hand and graveyard into their library.

cards.name: Leonin Shikari
lines: You may activate equip abilities any time you could cast an instant.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no permission letting its controller activate equip abilities at instant speed.

cards.name: Rust Elemental
lines: At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice another artifact. If you can't, tap this creature and you lose 4 life.
cards.backTranslation: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you control one or more other artifacts, sacrifice one other artifact you control. Otherwise, tap this creature and you lose 4 life.
differences: Text A's trigger always happens: if you can't sacrifice another artifact, the creature becomes tapped and you lose 4 life. Text B adds an intervening condition ('if you control one or more other artifacts'), so with no other artifacts the trigger does nothing and you do not lose 4 life or tap the creature.

cards.name: Space-Time Anomaly
lines: Target player mills cards equal to your life total.
cards.inexpressibleReason: millTargetPlayer takes a fixed number of cards, not a value, so "mills cards equal to your life total" cannot be stated.

cards.name: Profane Transfusion
lines: Two target players exchange life totals. You create an X/X colorless Horror artifact creature token, where X is the difference between those players' life totals.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect exchanges two target players' life totals, and the token X/X cannot be tied to that life difference.

cards.name: Fall of Cair Andros
lines: Whenever a creature an opponent controls is dealt excess noncombat damage, amass Orcs X, where X is that excess damage.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no trigger for a creature being dealt excess noncombat damage, and amass X needs the excess damage amount, which no value reads.

cards.name: Underdark Rift
lines: {5}, {T}, Exile this land: Roll a d10. Put target artifact, creature, or planeswalker into its owner's library just beneath the top X cards of that library, where X is the result. Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no random d10 roll and no destination that inserts the card into the library beneath a variable number X of cards.

cards.name: Genesis
lines: At the beginning of your upkeep, if this creature is in your graveyard, you may pay {2}{G}. If you do, return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
cards.backTranslation:
At the beginning of your upkeep, target creature card in your graveyard. You may pay {2}{G}. If you do, return that card to your hand.
This ability functions while this card is in your graveyard.

cards.name: Hellish Rebuke
lines: Until end of turn, permanents your opponents control gain "When this permanent deals damage to the player who cast ~, sacrifice this permanent. You lose 2 life."
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect grants a triggered ability to every permanent an opponent controls until end of turn; grantAbilityUntilEot takes a single target, and the granted reaction refers to the player who cast the spell.

cards.name: Calamity of Cinders
lines: ~ deals 6 damage to each untapped creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No selector can express 'untapped' at resolution (the tapped selector is event-only), so 'each untapped creature' cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Bazaar Trader
lines: {T}: Target player gains control of target artifact, creature, or land you control.
cards.backTranslation: {T}: Target player gains control of target artifact, creature, or land you control.

cards.name: Scheming Aspirant
lines: Whenever you proliferate, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No trigger event exists for a player proliferating.

cards.name: Hissing Quagmire
lines: {1}{B}{G}: Until end of turn, this land becomes a 2/2 black and green Elemental creature with deathtouch. It's still a land.
cards.backTranslation: {1}{B}{G}: Until end of turn, this land becomes a 2/2 black and green Elemental creature with deathtouch.

cards.name: Whiptongue Hydra
lines: When this creature enters, destroy all creatures with flying. Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature for each creature destroyed this way.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Destroying all creatures with flying and then putting a +1/+1 counter for each one destroyed has no schema form, since destroyEach does not expose how many objects it destroyed.

cards.name: Elminster's Simulacrum
lines: For each opponent, you create a token that's a copy of up to one target creature that player controls.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Each opponent gets its own 'up to one target creature that player controls' to copy, but createTokenCopyOf takes a single reference and no per-opponent target choice exists.

cards.name: Armory Automaton
lines: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, you may attach any number of target Equipment to it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Attaching any number of targeted Equipment to this creature has no schema shape, since attachSelfTo moves the source and attach moves the source or trigger object, not a chosen Equipment.

cards.name: Mind into Matter
lines: Draw X cards. Then you may put a permanent card with mana value X or less from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The put-from-hand effect (handToBattlefield) has no tapped option, so putting the permanent card onto the battlefield tapped cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Wildfire Devils
lines: When this creature enters and at the beginning of your upkeep, choose a player at random. That player exiles an instant or sorcery card from their graveyard. Copy that card. You may cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no way to choose a player at random, have that player exile a card from their graveyard, and cast a copy of it free.

cards.name: Myr Turbine
lines: {T}, Tap five untapped Myr you control: Search your library for a Myr creature card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
cards.backTranslation: {T}, Tap five Myr you control: Search your library for a Myr creature card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
differences: Text A requires tapping five untapped Myr you control; Text B says tap five Myr you control and omits 'untapped', so tapped Myr could be used to pay the cost.

cards.name: Meteor Crater
lines: {T}: Choose a color of a permanent you control. Add one mana of that color.
cards.backTranslation: {T}: Add one mana of one color among permanents.
differences: Text A lets you choose a color of a permanent you control; Text B adds one mana of one color among permanents with no 'you control' restriction, so permanents controlled by opponents would qualify.

cards.name: Run Amok
lines: Target attacking creature gets +3/+3 and gains trample until end of turn.
cards.backTranslation: Target attacking creature gets +3/+3 and gains trample until end of turn.

cards.name: Marching Duodrone
lines: Whenever this creature attacks, each player creates a Treasure token.
cards.backTranslation:
Whenever this creature attacks, create a Treasure token. Each opponent creates a Treasure token.
Treasure tokens have "{T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add {W}, {U}, {B}, {R}, or {G}."

cards.name: Daydream
lines: Exile target creature you control, then return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control with a +1/+1 counter on it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The blink must return the creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, but blinkTarget cannot place counters on the returned object and no follow-up effect can address the new object.

cards.name: Kari Zev's Expertise
lines: Gain control of target creature or Vehicle until end of turn. Untap it. It gains haste until end of turn.
cards.backTranslation:
Gain control of target creature or Vehicle until end of turn. Untap that permanent. It gains haste until end of turn.
Cast up to one spell from your hand with mana value 2 or less without paying its mana cost.

cards.name: Dragonlord Silumgar
lines: When ~ enters, gain control of target creature or planeswalker for as long as you control ~.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Gaining control for as long as you control the source has no duration: whileSourceOnBattlefield tracks the source being on the battlefield, not its controller.

cards.name: Bedlam
lines: Creatures can't block.
cards.backTranslation: Creatures can't block.

cards.name: Cephalid Facetaker
lines: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may have this creature become a copy of another target creature until end of turn, except it's 1/4 and has "~ can't be blocked."
cards.inexpressibleReason: becomeCopyOfTarget cannot set the copy's power and toughness to 1/4 or grant "can't be blocked" to the copy.

cards.name: Riders of Rohan
lines: Dash {4}{R}{W}
cards.backTranslation: Dash {4}{W}{R}
differences: Text B gives only the dash cost; it omits that a spell cast for its dash cost gains haste and is returned from the battlefield to its owner's hand at the beginning of the next end step.

cards.name: Abundant Harvest
lines: Choose land or nonland. Reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a card of the chosen kind. Put that card into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no way for the controller to choose land or nonland and then reveal until a card of the chosen kind is found.

cards.name: Loki's Scepter
lines: When ~ enters, gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. Until end of turn, it becomes a Villain in addition to its other types and gains haste.
cards.inexpressibleReason: 'Until end of turn, it becomes a Villain in addition to its other types' has no effect that adds a subtype until end of turn.

cards.name: Ebondeath, Dracolich
lines: You may cast this card from your graveyard if a creature not named ~ died this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The graveyard-cast permission needs a condition that a creature other than Ebondeath died this turn, but creaturesDiedThisTurn cannot exclude a creature named Ebondeath, Dracolich, so the condition cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Skullport Merchant
lines: {1}{B}, Sacrifice another creature or a Treasure: Draw a card.
cards.backTranslation: {1}{B}, Sacrifice another creature or Treasure you control: Draw a card.

cards.name: Emergent Ultimatum
lines: Search your library for up to three monocolored cards with different names and exile them. An opponent chooses one of those cards. Shuffle that card into your library. You may cast the other cards without paying their mana costs. Exile ~.
