cards.inexpressibleReason: Searching into exile, having an opponent choose one card to shuffle back, and casting the rest free has no composed schema form (search destinations exclude exile).

cards.name: Twisted Image
lines: Switch target creature's power and toughness until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect swaps a creature's power and toughness: pumpUntilEot only adds amounts, and no Value reads the target's toughness.

cards.name: Control Magic
lines: You control enchanted creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Control of the enchanted creature is a continuing static effect, and the schema has no control-changing static (ContinuousOp has no control layer), so it can only be written as an enters trigger that a response could stop.

cards.name: Mass of Mysteries
lines: At the beginning of combat on your turn, another target Elemental you control gains myriad until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Myriad is not a keyword the schema can grant: grantKeywordUntilEot and grantKeywordEachUntilEot take only the implemented KeywordAbility list, and no myriad effect exists.

cards.name: Aegis Angel
lines: When this creature enters, another target permanent gains indestructible for as long as you control this creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no effect that gives another target permanent indestructible for as long as you control this creature; grantKeywordUntilEot lasts only until end of turn.

cards.name: Evil Twin
lines: You may have this creature enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it has "{U}{B}, {T}: Destroy target creature with the same name as this creature."
cards.backTranslation:
This enters as a copy of a creature on the battlefield chosen as it enters.
{U}{B}, {T}: Destroy target creature with the same name as this creature.
differences: Text A lets you choose whether this creature enters as a copy ('You may have'). Text B makes the copy effect mandatory, so it always enters as a copy of a chosen creature.

cards.name: Scrap Mastery
lines: Each player exiles all artifact cards from their graveyard, then sacrifices all artifacts they control, then puts all cards they exiled this way onto the battlefield.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The ordered exile-from-graveyard, sacrifice-all-artifacts, then return-exiled sequence has no single effect form.

cards.name: Red Death, Shipwrecker
lines: Alluring Eyes — {T}: Goad target creature an opponent controls. That player draws a card. You add {R}.
cards.backTranslation: {T}: Goad target creature an opponent controls. The controller of that creature draws a card. Add {R}.

cards.name: Magister Sphinx
lines: When this creature enters, target player's life total becomes 10.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no effect that sets a player's life total to a fixed number ("life total becomes 10"); the available life ops only gain or lose an amount.

cards.name: Steelburr Champion
lines: Offspring {1}{W}
cards.backTranslation:
As an optional additional cost to cast this spell, you may pay {1}{W}.
When this enters, create a token that is a copy of this creature with power 1 and toughness 1, once for each time the optional additional cost was paid.

cards.name: Sigarda's Summons
lines: Creatures you control with +1/+1 counters on them have base power and toughness 4/4, have flying, and are Angels in addition to their other types.
cards.backTranslation: Each creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it has base power and toughness 4/4, has flying, and is an Angel in addition to its other creature types.

cards.name: Primeval Protector
lines: This spell costs {1} less to cast for each creature your opponents control.
cards.backTranslation: This spell costs {1} less to cast for each creature your opponents control.

cards.name: Spider-Man, Miles Morales
lines: Whenever ~ enters or attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control. Those creatures gain trample until end of turn.
cards.backTranslation:
When this enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control. Each other creature you control gains trample until end of turn.
Whenever this attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control. Each other creature you control gains trample until end of turn.

cards.name: Drafna, Founder of Lat-Nam
lines: {3}, {T}: Copy target artifact spell you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: copyTargetSpell has no way to make the copy of an artifact spell resolve as a token, which the line's "(The copy becomes a token.)" requires.

cards.name: Breathe Your Last
lines: Destroy target creature or planeswalker. You gain 1 life for each of its colors.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The life gain '1 life for each of its colors' needs a value counting the colors of the destroyed target, and the schema has no such value (only colors among permanents you control, the commander identity count, and the spell color count).

cards.name: Sorceress's Schemes
lines: Return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard or exiled card with flashback you own to your hand. Add {R}.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The second target option, an exiled card with flashback that you own, has no target zone or kind in the schema, so the target cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Delivery Moogle
lines: When this creature enters, search your library and/or graveyard for an artifact card with mana value 2 or less, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect searches the library and/or graveyard for a card and puts it into hand; searchLibraryAndOrGraveyardToBattlefield only moves cards to the battlefield.

cards.name: Paradoxical Outcome
lines: Return any number of target nonland, nontoken permanents you control to their owners' hands. Draw a card for each card returned to your hand this way.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The draw count equal to the number of targets chosen and returned has no Value in the schema, so "draw a card for each card returned" cannot be stated.

cards.name: Transcendent Dragon
lines: When this creature enters, if you cast it, counter target spell. If that spell is countered this way, exile it instead of putting it into its owner's graveyard, then you may cast it without paying its mana cost.
cards.inexpressibleReason: After the countered spell is exiled, 'you may cast it without paying its mana cost' has no effect that casts that just-exiled countered spell for free.

cards.name: Change of Plans
lines: Each of X target creatures you control connive. You may have any number of them phase out.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no operation that makes each chosen creature connive, and a target slot cannot be set to exactly X targets, so 'each of X target creatures you control connive' cannot be expressed.

cards.name: Trace of Abundance
lines: Whenever enchanted land is tapped for mana, its controller adds an additional one mana of any color.
cards.backTranslation: Mana abilities of enchanted permanent add one additional mana of any color when they are activated.

cards.name: By Force
lines: Destroy X target artifacts.
cards.inexpressibleReason: A target slot's count is a fixed min/max and cannot be set to the announced X, so the schema cannot say 'X target artifacts'.

cards.name: Otherworld Atlas
lines: {T}: Each player draws a card for each charge counter on this artifact.
cards.backTranslation: {T}: Each player draws a number of cards equal to the number of charge counters on this artifact.

cards.name: The Belligerent
lines: Whenever ~ attacks, create a Treasure token. Until end of turn, you may look at the top card of your library any time, and you may play lands and cast spells from the top of your library.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The until-end-of-turn permission to look at the top card of your library and play lands and cast spells from it has no schema form; castFromZone and playFromZone are permanent statics.

cards.name: Hashaton, Scarab's Fist
lines: Whenever you discard a creature card, you may pay {2}{U}. If you do, create a tapped token that's a copy of that card, except it's a 4/4 black Zombie.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The token copy must be tapped and be a 4/4 black Zombie; createTokenCopyOf has no tapped flag and no color or subtype override.

cards.name: Ultimate Green Goblin
lines: Mayhem {2}{B/R}
cards.inexpressibleReason: Mayhem's graveyard-cast permission depends on having discarded this card this turn, and no condition or alternative-cast field can express that.

cards.name: Lightning Axe
lines: As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card or pay {5}.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The additional cost 'discard a card or pay {5}' is a choice between two costs; spellAdditionalCosts would make both mandatory, and no optional-choice cost field exists.

cards.name: Warp World
lines: Each player shuffles all permanents they own into their library, then reveals that many cards from the top of their library. Each player puts all artifact, creature, and land cards revealed this way onto the battlefield, then does the same for enchantment cards, then puts all cards revealed this way that weren't put onto the battlefield on the bottom of their library.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no op that reveals a number of cards equal to the permanents shuffled and then puts revealed cards onto the battlefield by card type in ordered rounds with the remainder to the bottom.

cards.name: Kolaghan, the Storm's Fury
lines: Dash {3}{B}{R}
cards.backTranslation: Dash {3}{B}{R}
differences: Text B gives only the dash cost; it omits that a spell cast for its dash cost gains haste and is returned from the battlefield to its owner's hand at the beginning of the next end step.

cards.name: Chief Engineer
lines: Artifact spells you cast have convoke.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The convoke rule static has no filter, so it cannot grant convoke to artifact spells you cast.

cards.name: Inquisitorial Rosette
lines: Inquisition Agents — Whenever equipped creature attacks, create a 2/2 white Astartes Warrior creature token with vigilance that's attacking. Then attacking creatures gain menace until end of turn.
cards.backTranslation:
Whenever equipped creature attacks, create a 2/2 white Astartes Warrior creature token with vigilance that is attacking.
Each attacking creature gains menace until end of turn.

cards.name: The Prydwen, Steel Flagship
lines: Whenever another nontoken artifact you control enters, create a 2/2 white Human Knight creature token with "~ gets +2/+2 as long as an artifact entered the battlefield under your control this turn."
cards.inexpressibleReason: The token's conditional +2/+2 (as long as an artifact entered the battlefield under your control this turn) needs a this-turn entry-event condition, but the only counting condition checks artifacts still on the battlefield, which is not the same.

cards.name: Time Stop
lines: End the turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no effect in the schema that ends the turn.

cards.name: Captain America, Living Legend
lines: Whenever a creature you control becomes tapped during your turn, if it's the first time that creature has become tapped this turn, untap it.
cards.inexpressibleReason: A becomesTapped trigger's oncePerTurn is per ability, not per creature, so 'if it's the first time that creature has become tapped this turn' cannot be expressed for each creature.

cards.name: How to Start a Riot
lines: Creatures target player controls get +2/+0 until end of turn.
cards.backTranslation: Target creature gains menace until end of turn. Target player's creatures get +2/+0 until end of turn.

cards.name: Dreamdew Entrancer
lines: When this creature enters, tap up to one target creature and put three stun counters on it. If you control that creature, draw two cards.
validatorIssues: override.def.triggers[0].effects[0].target: effect target 0 does not reference an ordinary target slot
override.def.triggers[0].effects[1].target: effect target 0 does not reference an ordinary target slot
override.def.triggers[0].effects[2].checkTarget: effect target 0 does not reference an ordinary target slot
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no effect that taps, or checks control of, an 'up to one' variable-count target slot (only tapAndGoadEachChosen, which also goads), so tap plus the controller-conditional draw cannot be said exactly.

cards.name: Valor's Flagship
lines: When you cycle this card, create X 1/1 colorless Pilot creature tokens with "~ saddles Mounts and crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater."
cards.inexpressibleReason: There is no trigger for cycling this card, and the Pilot tokens' rider that they saddle Mounts and crew Vehicles as though their power were 2 greater has no schema shape.

cards.name: Kimahri, Valiant Guardian
lines: Ronso Rage — At the beginning of combat on your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on ~ and tap target creature an opponent controls. Then you may have ~ become a copy of that creature, except its name is ~ and it has vigilance and this ability.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The 'you may have it become a copy of that creature, except it has vigilance and this ability' clause needs becomeCopyOf to add a keyword and grant this Ronso Rage ability to the copy, but becomeCopyOf only adds types, supertypes and a name override.

cards.name: Floral Evoker
lines: {G}, Discard a creature card: Return target land card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The cost Discard a creature card has no creature-card filter (discardCard takes only a count), and graveyardToBattlefield has no option to return the land tapped.

cards.name: Hofri Ghostforge
lines: Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, exile it. If you do, create a token that's a copy of that creature, except it's a Spirit in addition to its other types and it has "When this token leaves the battlefield, return the exiled card to its owner's graveyard."
cards.inexpressibleReason: Exiling the dying creature and then making a copy linked to that exiled card, with a token leave-the-battlefield trigger that returns the exiled card, has no schema shape.

cards.name: Oversimplify
lines: Exile all creatures. Each player creates a 0/0 green and blue Fractal creature token and puts a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the total power of creatures they controlled that were exiled this way.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Each player's Fractal token needs a counter count equal to the total power of the creatures that player had exiled by the same spell, and no value reads the power of creatures exiled this way per player.

cards.name: Mardu Ascendancy
lines: Whenever a nontoken creature you control attacks, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token that's tapped and attacking.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever a nontoken creature you control attacks, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token that's attacking.
differences: Text A creates the Goblin token tapped and attacking; Text B creates it attacking only, without the tapped status.

cards.name: Roamer's Routine
lines: Harmonize {4}{G}
cards.inexpressibleReason: Harmonize's optional cost reduction (tap a creature you control to reduce the cost by its power) has no schema form, so the graveyard cast cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Krile Baldesion
lines: Trace Aether — Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, you may return target creature card with mana value equal to that spell's mana value from your graveyard to your hand. Do this only once each turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema cannot require the targeted creature card's mana value to equal the cast noncreature spell's mana value (manaValueAtMost/AtLeast take only fixed numbers), so the target restriction cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Jackdaw
lines: Whenever ~ deals combat damage to a player, you may discard your hand. If you do, draw a card for each artifact you control.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever this deals combat damage to a player, you may discard your hand, then draw a card for each artifact you control.

cards.name: Flickering Hound
lines: Whenever you cast a creature spell, exile up to one other target creature you control, then return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control.
cards.backTranslation: Whenever you cast a creature spell, exile up to one target other creature you control, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.

cards.name: Hall of Echoes
lines: {5}: ~ becomes a copy of target creature you control until end of turn. The "legend rule" doesn't apply to permanents you control this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no turn-scoped effect that exempts the permanents its controller controls from the legend rule, so 'the legend rule doesn't apply to permanents you control this turn' cannot be expressed (legendRuleDoesntApply is a permanent static, not a one-shot effect).

cards.name: Etali's Favor
lines: When this Aura enters, discover 3.
cards.backTranslation: When this enters, discover 3.

cards.name: Iron Man, Armored Avenger
lines: Whenever ~ attacks, other attacking modified creatures gain flying until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: 'Modified' creatures are those with counters, Equipment you control, or Auras you control, but isEquipped does not check who controls the Equipment, so the selector cannot say exactly 'modified'.

cards.name: Prodigy's Prototype
lines: Whenever one or more Vehicles you control attack, create a 1/1 colorless Pilot creature token with "~ crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater."
cards.inexpressibleReason: The Pilot token's 'crews Vehicles as though its power were 2 greater' has no static or rule form in the schema, since no crew-power modifier exists.

cards.name: Homing Sliver
lines: Each Sliver card in each player's hand has slivercycling {3}.
cards.inexpressibleReason: A static grant of slivercycling to Sliver cards in every player's hand cannot be expressed, because static selectors only reach battlefield permanents and there is no hand-zone selector.

cards.name: Old One Eye
lines: Fast Healing — At the beginning of your first main phase, you may discard two cards. If you do, return this card from your graveyard to your hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Fast Healing's 'you may discard two cards. If you do, return this card' has no exact form, since the discard cannot be gated on being able to discard two cards.

cards.name: Wall of Tanglecord
lines: {G}: ~ gains reach until end of turn.
cards.backTranslation: {G}: This creature gains reach until end of turn.

cards.name: Mass Mutiny
lines: For each opponent, gain control of up to one target creature that player controls until end of turn. Untap those creatures. They gain haste until end of turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: 'Up to one target creature that player controls' for each opponent needs a per-player variable target slot whose chosen creatures are each gained, and no effect gains control of each chosen target: gainControlTarget takes one target and gainControl takes a selector, not chosen targets.

cards.name: Superior Spider-Man
lines: Mind Swap — You may have ~ enter as a copy of any creature card in a graveyard, except his name is ~ and he's a 4/4 Spider Human Hero in addition to his other types. When you do, exile that card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: entersAsCopy has no way to name a creature card in a graveyard as the copy source, no name override or 4/4 base P/T setting, and no 'when you do, exile that card' follow-up.

cards.name: Lobelia Sackville-Baggins
lines: When Lobelia enters, exile target creature card from an opponent's graveyard that was put there from the battlefield this turn, then create X Treasure tokens, where X is the exiled card's power.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The target restriction 'put there from the battlefield this turn' on a graveyard card has no TargetSpec or selector field, so the exact card the ETB may exile cannot be specified.

cards.name: Irencrag Feat
lines: Add seven {R}. You can cast only one more spell this turn.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The clause 'You can cast only one more spell this turn' has no effect that limits the remaining spells this turn to one.

cards.name: Psychic Impetus
lines: Whenever enchanted creature attacks, you scry 2.
cards.backTranslation:
Enchant creature
Whenever enchanted creature attacks, scry 2.

cards.name: Bladewing, Deathless Tyrant
lines: Whenever ~ deals combat damage to a player or planeswalker, for each creature card in your graveyard, create a 2/2 black Zombie Knight creature token with menace.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The trigger fires on combat damage to a player or a planeswalker, but dealsCombatDamageToPlayer covers players only and no trigger covers planeswalker combat damage.

cards.name: Afterlife Insurance
lines: Creatures you control gain afterlife 1 until end of turn. Draw a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Afterlife is not a KeywordAbility in the schema, so grantKeywordEachUntilEot cannot grant 'afterlife 1' to your creatures.

cards.name: Plague of Vermin
lines: Starting with you, each player may pay any amount of life. Repeat this process until no one pays life. Each player creates a 1/1 black Rat creature token for each 1 life they paid this way.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema has no repeated any-amount life-payment loop in which each player pays life and then creates one Rat per life paid.

cards.name: Too Greedily, Too Deep
lines: Put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. That creature deals damage equal to its power to each other creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The damage equals the returned creature's power after it moves to the battlefield, and no schema form binds the moved creature's power to the damage amount.

cards.name: Familiar's Ruse
lines: As an additional cost to cast this spell, return a creature you control to its owner's hand.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The additional cost 'return a creature you control to its owner's hand' has no AbilityCost kind; the cost list has no return-to-hand component for a controlled creature.

cards.name: Cavalier of Gales
lines: When this creature dies, shuffle it into its owner's library, then scry 2.
cards.backTranslation: When this dies, put it into its owner's library, 1 card from the top. Then shuffle. Then scry 2.

cards.name: Bladegriff Prototype
lines: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, destroy target nonland permanent of that player's choice that one of your opponents controls.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The destroy target is chosen by the damaged player ('of that player's choice'), and the schema has no effect where an opponent chooses the target for the controller's destroy.

cards.name: New Horizons
lines: Enchanted land has "{T}: Add two mana of any one color."
cards.backTranslation: Enchanted permanent has "{T}: Add one mana of any color. Add one mana of any color. These two mana are linked."
differences: Text A gives two mana of any one color (both mana the same color). Text B gives two linked mana each of any color chosen separately, so they can be different colors.

cards.name: Magmatic Hellkite
lines: When this creature enters, destroy target nonbasic land an opponent controls. Its controller searches their library for a basic land card, puts it onto the battlefield tapped with a stun counter on it, then shuffles.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The schema's basic-land search-and-destroy ops are optional searches with no way to put a stun counter on the searched land, and the line's search is mandatory.

cards.name: Kinscaer Sentry
lines: Whenever this creature attacks, you may put a creature card with mana value X or less from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking, where X is the number of attacking creatures you control.
cards.inexpressibleReason: handToBattlefield cannot put a card onto the battlefield tapped and attacking, and no effect puts a card from hand into combat as an attacker.

cards.name: Combustion Technique
lines: ~ deals damage equal to 2 plus the number of Lesson cards in your graveyard to target creature. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The 'if that creature would die this turn, exile it instead' replacement has no schema form, so the damage-then-exile behavior cannot be stated exactly.

cards.name: Red Sun's Twilight
lines: Destroy up to X target artifacts. If X is 5 or more, for each artifact destroyed this way, create a token that's a copy of it. Those tokens gain haste. Exile them at the beginning of the next end step.
cards.inexpressibleReason: 'Destroy up to X target artifacts' needs a target count equal to the announced X, but TargetSpec.count takes fixed numbers only, and the follow-up token copies of each artifact destroyed this way are not expressible.

cards.name: Belonging
lines: Encore {6}{W}{W}
cards.inexpressibleReason: Encore (exile from graveyard, one haste token copy per opponent that attacks that opponent if able, sacrificed at the next end step) has no schema form.

cards.name: Mob Verdict
lines: Each player secretly votes for another player, then those votes are revealed. For each vote an opponent received, ~ deals 2 damage to that player and each creature that player controls. For each vote you received, draw a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The secret vote in which each player votes for another player, with damage and draws computed per vote received, has no schema form (councilVote takes two fixed choices, not a vote for a player).

cards.name: Mayael's Aria
lines: At the beginning of your upkeep, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control if you control a creature with power 5 or greater. Then you gain 10 life if you control a creature with power 10 or greater. Then you win the game if you control a creature with power 20 or greater.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The final clause 'you win the game if you control a creature with power 20 or greater' needs an effect that makes you win the game, and no effect in the schema does that.

cards.name: Cleansing Wildfire
lines: Destroy target land. Its controller may search their library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
cards.backTranslation:
Destroy target land. Its controller may search their library for a basic land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
Draw a card.
differences: Text A says the controller of the destroyed land then searches and the library is shuffled ('then shuffle'); Text B omits the shuffle, so the library is not shuffled after the search.

cards.name: Havoc Eater
lines: When this creature enters, for each opponent, goad up to one target creature that opponent controls. Put X +1/+1 counters on this creature, where X is the total power of creatures goaded this way.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The +1/+1 counter count is the total power of the creatures goaded this way across a per-opponent 'up to one' target choice, and no value sums the power of several chosen targets.

cards.name: Dog Umbra
lines: As long as another player controls enchanted creature, it can't attack or block. Otherwise, this Aura has umbra armor.
cards.inexpressibleReason: Umbra armor (destruction replaced by removing all damage and destroying this Aura) has no schema field.

cards.name: Southern Air Temple
lines: When ~ enters, put X +1/+1 counters on each creature you control, where X is the number of Shrines you control.
cards.backTranslation: When this enters, put a number of +1/+1 counters equal to the number of Shrine permanents you control on each creature you control.

cards.name: Terror Tide
lines: Fathomless descent — All creatures get -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of permanent cards in your graveyard.
cards.backTranslation: Each creature gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of cards in your graveyard that are artifacts, Battles, creatures, enchantments, lands, or planeswalkers.

cards.name: Surrak, Elusive Hunter
lines: Whenever a creature you control or a creature spell you control becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, draw a card.
cards.inexpressibleReason: The trigger watches a creature spell you control on the stack becoming the target of an opponent's spell or ability, but becomesTargeted only reads permanents as its subject.

cards.name: Merchant Raiders
lines: Whenever this creature or another Pirate you control enters, tap up to one target creature. That creature doesn't untap during its controller's untap step for as long as you control this creature.
cards.inexpressibleReason: No effect keeps a target creature from untapping for as long as you control the source; doesntUntapDuringUntapStep applies only to the card itself.

cards.name: Dimir Keyrune
lines: {U}{B}: ~ becomes a 2/2 blue and black Horror artifact creature until end of turn and can't be blocked this turn.
cards.backTranslation: {U}{B}: This becomes a blue and black Horror creature with base power and toughness 2/2 until end of turn. It can't be blocked until end of turn.
differences: Text A makes the source a blue and black Horror artifact creature; Text B makes it only a blue and black Horror creature and omits the artifact card type.
